raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misclassified the transmitted disturbance as electromagnetic by conflating the EM nature of interatomic forces with the macroscopic wave type; in reality, the impulse travels through the contacting bowling balls as a mechanical compression (sound) wave, i.e., a longitudinal wave, transmitted via brief elastic deformations at the contacts (Newton’s cradle behavior).
